create.name: Katharine Chestnut
create.bio:
Katharine Chestnut is a mindfulness teacher, author and coach based in Atlanta, Georgia. She spent decades in corporate marketing, much of it in the trade-show world, before moving into coworking; she founded the Atlanta workspace Alkaloid Networks and helped start a citywide alliance of coworking operators. Years of high pressure and a painful marriage led her back to meditation and Eastern ideas she had explored when younger, and she went on to train as a behavioural kinesiologist and to study mindfulness for more than twenty years.

Her teaching is aimed mostly at busy, high-achieving women who look settled from the outside but feel stretched within. She keeps practices short and repeatable: breath-led meditations, reflective writing and small daily habits rather than big overhauls. Her journaling method, set out in the book Inner Affirmations and its follow-up of 365 prompts, uses writing to hear one's own inner voice more clearly. She runs self-paced online courses and a private coaching programme, posts weekly talks and full-moon meditations on YouTube about self-trust, rest and people-pleasing, and has shared guided practices on Insight Timer since 2019. She also speaks at conferences on bringing mindfulness into working life.

books.title: Inner Affirmations
books.author: Katharine Chestnut
books.description: A practical guide to building a regular journaling habit as a mindfulness practice. Chestnut sets out her own method for writing affirmations that come from your inner voice, with exercises and a simple ritual for daily writing time.

books.title: Inner Affirmation Inspirations: 365 Journaling Prompts for Personalized Affirmations and Self-Discovery
books.author: Katharine Chestnut
books.description: A year of daily writing prompts, one for each day, that builds on the method in Inner Affirmations. Each prompt invites a short reflection that ends in an affirmation of your own.

courses.title: 7-Day Mindful Reset
courses.description: A self-guided week of short meditations, simple mindfulness activities and reflection prompts, one theme per day. Printable trackers and journal pages come with it.

courses.title: Affirm Your Way to Mindful Living: The Journaling Quick Start Course
courses.description: A short online course on starting or deepening a journaling practice, taught through videos and guided exercises. It introduces her Inner Affirmations approach and can be taken at your own pace.

courses.title: Mindful Life Private Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching over six or twelve months, with video calls, messaging and a weekly live group meditation. The focus is on keeping a steady mindfulness practice going in a full life.
courses.price: From $257 USD a month (12 months); $327 USD a month (6 months)

courses.title: Calm You Can Return To
courses.description: A multi-day Insight Timer course by Katharine Chestnut on building a sense of calm you can come back to during the day. Available to Insight Timer Member Plus subscribers.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Intentional Mornings For Mindful Living
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of morning practices for starting the day with intention. Available to Insight Timer Member Plus subscribers.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Katharine Chestnut on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free library of guided meditations, breathing practices, journaling-themed reflections and sleep stories. Free to listen to in the Insight Timer app or on the web.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 6.5k (profile, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube 676 (channel header next to @katharinechestnut, 1 Nov 2026); no Instagram, Facebook page, X or TikTok linked from her site or Insight Timer profile → ~7.2k total → local_hero
flags: Amazon /dp/ pages returned 500 (curl and WebFetch); both ASINs come from her own site's Amazon links (B09GRKGZJW direct, B0CL2XVYXT via her amzn.to link) and are Kindle editions; a human may want to confirm them and swap in paperback ASINs.

The Inner Affirmations blurb on her site tells her own story of depression, PTSD and a covert-narcissist relationship; the book itself is a journaling guide, so it was kept with a neutral description. Borderline under the health rule.

Her meditations page lists abuse recovery and stress/anxiety among its topics, and some site testimonials mention trauma and sleep; her offerings themselves are sold on mindfulness and calm, so the plan was written rather than skipped. Owner may want to check under the strict health rule.
Insight Timer bio could not be quoted word for word (WebFetch would only give short excerpts); the bio check used the two excerpts it returned plus her site pages.
Only one photo used (site headshot); the YouTube avatar is the same image cropped, and the Banff photo shows half her face.
left_out: Codependency YouTube series and the Insight Timer course 'Codependency: Stop Losing Yourself In Relationships' (condition-style framing, borderline).
Insight Timer course 'Reflect, Heal, And Prepare For The New Year' (seasonal and 'heal' wording) and 'The Relax & Restore Breathwork Series' (kept to two IT courses).
Breathe Calmly, Feel Calmly page on her site (described as reducing anxiety).
Full-moon meditations on YouTube (named for specific 2026 moons) and a sleep story (over an hour, not teaching).
YouTube view counts could not be read from the channel page; videos chosen as recent evergreen talks rather than by views.
Inner Affirmations journals and the $5 '4 Mindfulness Exercises' ebook (sold on her site only, no Amazon listing confirmed).
